stories.headline: KittenML releases Kitten TTS 2 Mini and Nano models for efficient CPU text-to-speech
stories.summary: KittenML introduced two new text-to-speech models, Mini and Nano, that run on standard CPUs without heavy frameworks. Mini supports 16 languages and 118 voices, while Nano supports 8 languages and 37 voices.
stories.whyItMatters: These models make high-quality speech synthesis accessible on low-cost hardware.

stories.headline: Salesforce launches SOV-Transcribe-1 open-weight speech recognition model
stories.summary: Salesforce released SOV-Transcribe-1, an open-weight model for automatic speech recognition with high English accuracy and multilingual support. Users can steer transcription behavior using natural language prompts.
stories.whyItMatters: The model provides a customizable, open alternative for developers building speech-enabled applications.

stories.headline: Anthropic provides METR team deep access for independent model risk assessments
stories.summary: Anthropic is giving a nonprofit team from METR extensive system access to evaluate the safety of its frontier AI models. The company also works with other evaluators such as SecureBio and Accenture to broaden third-party oversight.
stories.whyItMatters: Independent evaluation helps ensure AI systems are safer and more transparent before wider deployment.
